taskDisposition.reason: Predecessor D-001 intentionally stopped at verification. This brainstorm proves a distinct runnable behavior tier with its own artifact, runtime, storage, packaging, and freshness contract.

safetyAndConflictSurface: Derive a short per-worktree target; reject a deep worktree-local target by default.
Use an exclusive owner lock and record canonical worktree, repository, dirty-state, toolchain, profile, bins, timestamps, and hashes.
Do not use binary hash equality as freshness; restored-source rebuilds produced valid byte-different executables.
Detect running target executables and report exact path/PID; never kill by process name.
Guard cleanup with the owner manifest and never delete the release target or an arbitrary caller path.
Keep the first implementation in wrapper scripts/tests/docs; avoid patched-Codex Rust and Cargo.toml edits.
Production release profile, publish command, four-binary vendor layout, and pinned ripgrep checks remain unchanged.
testStrategy: Deterministic target derivation, path rejection, environment clearing, selection, lock, and cleanup tests.
Manifest tests for current, dirty, changed-HEAD, changed-profile, and interrupted states.
Real no-op, private core-edit, public core-edit, and restoration measurements with byte-safe source handling.
Exact-path offline, authenticated no-tool, and benign shell-tool smoke with CODEX_CORE_PATH unset.
Explicit sandbox-helper and rg.exe preflight reporting.
Retain T1/T2 checks and one optimized publish smoke outside the fast lane.
rollback: Remove runnable-tier additions from the existing verifier, measurement script, tests, and docs, then remove only owner-verified fast targets. Existing targeted, workspace, executable, and publish semantics, release targets, publish profile, and installed binaries are unaffected.

planSeed.goal: Implement an additive, explicit, default-off fast-runnable Codex development lane using the measured dev-small incremental arm while preserving all correctness and release gates.
planSeed.prerequisite: Branch from or rebase onto accepted predecessor HEAD 2a95dd19c89fc99492d0e5a25d77cb070fe77da3. Preserve targeted, workspace, executable, and publish tiers; add runnable rather than creating a parallel command or repurposing executable.
stories: Extend scripts/verify-core-change.{sh,mjs} with explicit runnable dispatch that derives a short per-worktree target, clears conflicting Rust, sccache, and profile overrides, enables incremental compilation, disables sccache, and builds the measured launcher/core pair.
Add exclusive target ownership, provenance/freshness manifests, interrupted-build handling, running-executable detection, and guarded cleanup.
Codify launcher/core as the minimum artifact; expose optional helper and rg.exe preflights without weakening or duplicating publish packaging.
Add exact-path offline, authenticated, and benign shell-tool smokes that prove the target executable ran.
Extend scripts/measure-build.ps1 and predecessor deterministic tests, then run one real private/public core-edit evidence pass while retaining T1/T2 and optimized executable/publish gates.
Update agent and build-performance documentation with contract separation, cold/warm expectations, storage, concurrency, limitations, and rollback.
acceptanceCriteria: Warmed private and public core edits build a runnable launcher/core pair in at most 600 seconds.
No-op builds invoke no rustc and complete in at most 30 seconds.
Exact-path authenticated launcher and benign shell-tool smokes succeed.
Concurrent cross-worktree mutation and stale/interrupted provenance fail closed.
The release profile and publish command remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
Code and docs review converge with no Medium-or-higher findings.
